name: @aws/durable-execution-sdk-js-insight-desktop
description: Standalone desktop app (Electron) for Workflow Insight — reuses the VS Code extension's webview UI and host logic, for customers who prefer not to run it inside VS Code.
comment: electron/electron-builder are intentionally not committed to the workspace lockfile; install them once with `npm install electron@^43 electron-builder@26.15.3 --legacy-peer-deps` (see README). esbuild/typescript/jsonc-parser ARE real runtime deps (deploy.ts bundles handlers with esbuild; agent/darTs/inferTypes use the TS compiler; jsonc-parser locates .dar node positions for source maps), require()'d at module load - a packaged app has no workspace root to hoist-resolve them from, so they must be physically present in THIS package's own node_modules/. A plain `npm install` here still resolves through the npm workspace (hoists to the root), so instead: `npm install esbuild@0.24.2 typescript@5.8.3 jsonc-parser@3.3.1 --prefix .runtime` then copy `.runtime/node_modules/{esbuild,typescript,@esbuild,jsonc-parser}` into `./node_modules/` (gitignored, packaging-only) before running electron-builder. See README's packaging section.
